story.title: The place our founder wanted to find
story.p1: Skin Era comes from its founder's experience as a client: little technique, little attention, neglected facilities and very little awareness of real skin care.
story.p2: Instead of settling, she decided to create the space she would have wanted to find: one where every step is explained, every detail is cared for and skin is treated with respect from the very first appointment.

hero.title: We answer your questions
hero.lead: Everything you might be wondering before your first appointment. If you can't find your answer, book your appointment and we'll answer it.

before.q: Is my body suitable for waxing?
before.a: In most cases, yes. Before we start, we check your skin and sensitivity in person. If something isn't advisable that day, such as an irritation, an injury, an active infection or certain treatments, we'll tell you honestly and suggest waiting. Your safety comes first.

before.q: Can I come during my period?
before.a: You can, although your skin may be more sensitive those days. If you prefer, book a few days before or after; we'll guide you when you book.

before.q: How long should the hair be?
before.a: Ideally about half a centimeter, roughly the size of a grain of rice. If it's longer, we trim it; if it's too short, we'll let you know so the wax works well.

before.q: Who do you serve, and from what age?
before.a: We welcome women and men from age 16. If you have questions about your case or the area you're interested in, book your appointment and we'll guide you.

first.q: It's my first time, what can I expect?
first.a: We greet you at reception, take you to a private room, and your technician explains the procedure before starting. During the service we talk you through each step, and afterwards we give you care recommendations for your skin.

first.q: What if I don't feel comfortable?
first.a: You can pause or stop the service at any time. Your comfort matters most and your technician works at your pace.
There may be brief discomfort; it varies by person, area and sensitivity. We choose the technique based on your skin, warn you before each step, and with consistency it usually gets easier.

hygiene.a: No. We use a new applicator each time you need one and never reuse the same one in the wax. Treatment rooms, tools, warmers and dishes are also kept spotless and in plain sight.

hygiene.q: Do you use hard wax or soft wax?
hygiene.a: We choose on the spot, based on your skin assessment, the area and your hair type. You don't have to decide beforehand: we explain what we'll use and why.
We work with waxes made from traceable ingredients, with no animal testing, designed for different skin types.

after.q: What if I need a touch-up?
after.a: If you need a touch-up after your service, we do it at no cost within 3 days.

after.q: If I have little hair, do you charge the same?
after.a: Yes, the cost is the same. The price depends on the area and the service, not on the amount of hair. If you have questions about your case, tell us and we'll guide you before booking.

When we finish we give you personalized recommendations. In general, avoid direct sun, sauna, pools, intense exercise and irritating products for the first 24 to 48 hours, and keep your skin moisturized.

benefits.title: Benefits of waxing you may not know about
benefits.lead: Beyond smooth skin: what happens when hair is removed from the root and why so many people give up the razor.
benefits.intro: If you've waxed before, you probably know it lasts longer than shaving. What almost nobody mentions are the other effects: how the texture of your skin changes, what happens to your hair over the months and why the razor leaves that rough feeling.

sections.title: It's removed from the root
sections.text: A razor cuts hair at skin level. Wax removes it from the root, and new hair has to grow back from scratch. That's why skin stays smooth for several weeks, usually between 3 and 6, depending on the area and your growth rate.

sections.title: No stubble feeling
sections.text: When you shave, the hair is left with a blunt, cut tip, and that tip feels rough when it grows back. With wax, new hair grows in with a fine, natural tip, so its return feels softer.

sections.title: With consistency, hair tends to grow back finer
sections.text: Many people notice that after several sessions, hair grows back finer and less dense.
sections.text2: It doesn't happen the same way for everyone or in every area, but it's one of the changes people mention most.

sections.title: A light exfoliation as a bonus
sections.text: When the wax is removed, some dead cells on the surface come off too, so skin usually looks more even and smooth after the service.
sections.text2: It doesn't replace your skin care routine, but it's an extra benefit you didn't expect.

sections.title: Less time in your routine
sections.text: With a razor you have to repeat every few days. With wax, upkeep comes down to one appointment every few weeks, with no blades, nicks or foam.

sections.title: A moment for yourself
sections.text: Done in a calm place with good care, a waxing appointment is also a pause in your week. At Skin Era we look after the atmosphere, the hygiene and the way we treat you so the experience feels that way.

myth.label: Myth
myth.title: Shaving makes hair thicker
myth.text: Not true: shaving doesn't change hair thickness or amount. What changes is the tip, which is left blunt and feels rougher. That's why it seems thicker, even though it isn't.

caution.title: Good to know
caution.text: Wax can leave mild redness for a few hours, and not every skin type or situation is suitable that day. That's why we check your skin in person before starting and, if something isn't advisable, we'll tell you. This information is general and doesn't replace advice from a health professional.
